context: Two teens trade complaints about recent test schedules
purpose: Teach: 凄く/きのう/ふたつ/即ち/如何/念頭/先ず/一昨日

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いてよ、一昨日の数学のテスト、難しすぎて泣きそうだったんだけど。
lines.en: Hey listen, the math test the day before yesterday was so hard I almost cried.
lines.style: Casual teen complaint, exasperated rising tone with playful frustration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる、凄くムズかったよね。きのうの英語も最悪だったし。
lines.en: I know, it was super tough, right? Yesterday's English was the worst too.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen drawl, sighing agreement with weary slumping energy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも今週ふたつもテストあるとかさ、なんなのこのスケジュール。
lines.en: Plus we have two tests this week—what even is this schedule.
lines.style: Indignant rant, voice rising with dramatic teenage outrage and disbelief.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生がさ、『生徒の負担を念頭に置いて』とか言ってたけど絶対ウソじゃん。
lines.en: The teacher said 'keeping students' burden in mind' but that's totally a lie.
lines.style: Mocking impression of teacher voice, then dropping to flat sarcastic teen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。即ち私たちは犠牲者、みたいな?って感じだよね。
lines.en: So true. Like, in other words, we're the victims, basically.
lines.style: Mock-philosophical declaration, half-joking with rising question intonation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺、一昨日から全然寝てないんだけど。マジで頭ぼーっとしてる。
lines.en: I literally haven't slept since the day before yesterday. My head's totally fuzzy.
lines.style: Dragging exhausted male teen voice, half-laughing through visible fatigue.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先ずちゃんと寝なって。きのうママにも同じこと言われたわ、私。
lines.en: First of all, just sleep properly. Mom told me the same thing yesterday.
lines.style: Bossy older-sister tone, then quickly turning self-deprecating and giggly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 終わったらデカいパフェ食いに行こうぜ、ご褒美にさ。
lines.en: When it's over let's go grab a huge parfait, as a reward, yeah?
lines.style: Brightening male voice, enthusiastic invitation with hopeful upward lift.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 賛成、それを念頭にあと三日頑張る。テスト如何にかなれー!
lines.en: Agreed, with that in mind I'll push through three more days. Tests, somehow work out!
lines.style: Determined cheerful agreement, ending in playful shouted teen prayer.
